documents.title: Residency Renewal Application Status Notice
documents.summary: Status notice the citizen-service assistant is delegated to post for one renewal application. The Government Trust extension sends this notice body unchanged.

sections.heading: Workflow
fields: POST to the AUTHORIZED endpoint, route COLLECT

sections.heading: Notice body
paragraphs: Synthetic renewal application RS-1042: status received

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: The assistant may post this notice and nothing else. Any other destination, a reused capability, an expired or foreign capability, a proof signed by another key or a revoked identity is refused before the research gateway is consulted.
